summary: First full run on giftaol.ca v0.11. Backend: 17 pytest tests, all pass (auth, httpOnly cookie, bcrypt, brute-force lockout, verify-code, daily code limit 429, change password, non-admin 403, checkout min/max, demo-confirm + double-confirm 409, Harmony lookup/redeem, idempotent replay, over-balance 409, used_up, wrong-entry lock 423 + admin unlock, config min/max, content save/rollback, request logs + code masking). Frontend checked with Playwright: EN/FR switch stays after reload (localStorage giftaol_lang); CTA goes to /login?next=/gifts/new; password login works and goes to next; /login while logged in goes to /dashboard; amount error; payment step with demo banner; confirmation page shows all required elements and a 5-item next-steps list; dashboard masked code, reveal, copy, status badges (Partly used, Used up, Locked, DEMO) and redemptions list; gift detail; email-code limit message; verify-code UI (request-code mocked with page.route to save email quota); non-admin has no Admin nav and is sent from /admin to /dashboard; change password; logout; protected route returns to the original page; admin content editor (EN+FR publish, restore previous); config min change shows in the new-gift range; locked-code unlock; Hack Monitor search and filters; mobile 390px; Google button redirects via auth.emergentagent.com. Blocking problem at start: the Turnstile script was missing from the served index.html (stale dev server), so no login worked until I restarted the frontend.

critical.issue: After about 10 emails in a few minutes, the provider returned HTTP 429. send_with_retry only retries 3 times over about 6s, then gives up. Result: the gift email was marked email_status=failed ('Email not delivered' on the dashboard), the redemption emails failed, and POST /api/auth/request-code returned 502.

When the email fails, the backend returns status 502. Cloudflare/ingress replaces the body, so the user sees 'The origin web server returned an invalid or incomplete response to Cloudflare...' instead of the bilingual email_failed message. Also, code_request_log is written before sending, so a failed send still uses up one of the user's 5 daily codes.

minor.issue: The code never expires. created_at is stored but never checked, so an old 6-digit code works forever until it is used. The only attempt limit is in memory (10 per 15 min per email) and is lost when the backend restarts.

The first publish when no landing_content doc exists does not archive a version. The UI still adds 1 to its versions counter, so 'Restore previous' becomes enabled and a click returns 404. Seen in UI: after save1, the rollback button was enabled with 0 versions in the DB.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' is used with allow_credentials=True. Use an explicit origin list.
en/fr are free-form dicts with no schema validation.
wrong_entries is not reset after a correct lookup. Wrong entries made long apart still add up toward the lock.

ui_bugs.issue: The served HTML was stale: no Turnstile <script>, old meta description. window.turnstile was undefined, so every login and send-code failed with 'Please complete the security check first.' A frontend restart fixed it. After changing public/index.html, always restart the frontend and check that the served HTML has the script.
Horizontal scroll (scrollWidth 468 vs 390). The hero image preview row (file input + img w-20) and the list fieldsets overflow.

integration_issues.issue: The Cloudflare error text is shown in request-code-error (see the backend 502 issue).

In dev, React.StrictMode runs the tracking effect twice, so every page view is logged twice. The second entry has referrer = its own URL. Use a guard against double runs. Production builds are not affected.

issues: Table rows are very tall and need sideways scrolling to see URL, referrer and status. Consider a card layout on mobile.
The 'Balance / Amount' label is indented and does not line up with the amount below it.
The tab list wraps and 'Hack monitor' sits centered on its own line.
Uses the browser's default 'Choose File' input. Use a styled upload button.

action_items: Handle managed-email 429: longer backoff, or queue a background retry for gift and redemption emails. Do not mark the gift email as permanently failed after about 6s.
Return 503 (or a 200 with an error flag) instead of 502 from request-code and resend-email, so ingress/Cloudflare does not replace the response. Add a frontend fallback message for non-JSON errors.
Write code_request_log only after the email is sent (or remove the entry when sending fails).
Expire email verification codes, e.g. 15 minutes using created_at, and limit attempts per code in the DB.
Fix the content editor versions counter: use the versions value returned by the server after save and rollback.
Fix horizontal overflow in the Admin Content Editor on mobile.
After any change to public/index.html, restart the frontend and confirm the Turnstile script is in the served HTML.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_auth.verify_code: does not check code age. It also resets the password of any existing user (including Google users), which works as a password reset. That is fine as long as the code has a short expiry.
routes_auth.request_code: the daily limit is checked with count-then-insert, which can race. Low risk.
routes_harmony._find_gift: the wrong-entry check only runs on the first 8 characters. Entries shorter than 8 characters never count toward the lock (acceptable).
server.py: tracking of the '/api/track' page path does not mask codes if a code ever appears in a frontend URL or query string. Currently none do.
Rate limits are in memory and per process. They reset on restart and are not shared if there are several workers.

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17 pytest); email delivery degraded by provider 429
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows work after the frontend restart; mobile admin overflow and the email-failure message are open)

seed_data_creation: Test users, gifts, payments, redemptions, code logs and verifications were created and then deleted by id or email. landing_content and app_config did not exist before testing, so I deleted them afterwards (the app is back to defaults). The Harmony key was rotated several times, so the current active key is a new one created by the tests: rotate again before any real Harmony integration. Request logs from testing are kept.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests -n 0 -v. The tests clean up after themselves and need -n 0 because they share config state. Each full run sends about 5 real emails (gift and redemption emails to example.com, plus one to delivered@resend.dev), and the managed email returns 429 quickly, so avoid repeated runs or mock email. In Playwright, mock /api/auth/request-code with page.route and upsert an HMAC code hash in email_verifications (see /tmp/seedcode.py pattern) to test verify-code. The Turnstile test widget auto-passes in headless Chrome once api.js loads (wait about 4s before submitting).
rca of the issue: Login broken at start: the CRA dev server was serving an older index.html without the Turnstile api.js tag (index.html had been edited at 16:54 and not picked up), so window.turnstile was undefined and no token was produced. Fixed with 'sudo supervisorctl restart frontend'. 'Email not delivered' / Cloudflare error: the backend logs show integrations.emergentagent.com email/send returning 429 Too Many Requests. send_with_retry gives up after 3 quick tries, request-code returns 502, and the edge replaces the 502 body.
